verdict.rationale: n8n offers self-hosting on your own infrastructure (n8n-docs-3, n8n-gh-8, n8n-comm-16), which gives users full control over where their data lives and implicitly prevents it from being sent to n8n's cloud or used by n8n for any AI training. However, there is no explicit policy statement, opt-out setting, or documentation addressing AI-training data usage specifically. Missing for 10: an explicit data-usage/AI-training policy or opt-out toggle, independent confirmation that self-hosted data is never used for model training, and clarity on cloud-plan data handling for AI training purposes.
